query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT 'counts' AS kind, json_build_object('quizzes',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.quizzes),'questions',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.quiz_questions),'answers',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.quiz_answers),'attempts',(SELECT count(*) FROM public.quiz_attempts)) AS payload UNION ALL SELECT 'rls' AS kind, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('table',c.relname,'enabled',c.relrowsecurity,'forced',c.relforcerowsecurity)) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND c.relname IN ('quizzes','quiz_questions','quiz_answers','quiz_attempts')) AS payload UNION ALL SELECT 'policies' AS kind, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('table',tablename,'policy',policyname,'command',cmd,'roles',roles)) FROM pg_policies WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('quizzes','quiz_questions','quiz_answers','quiz_attempts')) AS payload UNION ALL SELECT 'functions' AS kind, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('name',p.proname,'anon',has_function_privilege('anon',p.oid,'EXECUTE'),'authenticated',has_function_privilege('authenticated',p.oid,'EXECUTE'))) FROM pg_proc p JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=p.pronamespace WHERE n.nspname='public' AND p.proname IN ('get_my_quiz_catalog','get_my_quiz_detail','start_quiz_attempt','submit_quiz_attempt','get_my_quiz_attempt_result','get_my_quiz_history','get_admin_quiz_overview')) AS payload UNION ALL SELECT 'indexes' AS kind, (SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('table',tablename,'index',indexname)) FROM pg_indexes WHERE schemaname='public' AND tablename IN ('quizzes','quiz_questions','quiz_answers','quiz_attempts')) AS payload) AS audit LIMIT 5;
